Simulate a small survey design.

Source: R/simulate.R
simulate_design.Rd

Draws a single-stage cluster sample with optional strata. The columns are a regression outcome y, covariates x1 and x2, four repeated measures y1 to y4 from a linear growth curve, a positive weight w, and the sampling unit identifiers. Intended for examples and tests, not as a population generator for applied analyses.

Usage

simulate_design(
  n_psu = 10L,
  n_per = 5L,
  n_strata = 1L,
  nest = FALSE,
  lonely = FALSE,
  domain = FALSE,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

n_psu

Primary sampling units in each stratum. For lonely = TRUE this is the size of each non-lonely stratum, and at least 2.

n_per

Observations in each primary sampling unit.

n_strata

Number of strata. A value below 2 gives an unstratified design, except when lonely = TRUE, which always uses three strata.

nest

If TRUE, primary sampling unit labels restart in every stratum and survey::svydesign() is called with nest = TRUE. Requires at least two strata.

lonely

If TRUE, the first stratum contains one primary sampling unit, so survey::svymean() follows survey.lonely.psu.

domain

If TRUE, the design is passed through subset() so that every row with the smallest primary sampling unit label is out of the domain. With nest = TRUE that drops one unit from each stratum and keeps the original sample size of units in the variance.

seed

Optional seed. The random generator is not changed when seed is NULL.

Value

A survey.design2 object.

References

Oberski D (2014). "lavaan.survey: An R Package for Complex Survey Analysis of Structural Equation Models." Journal of Statistical Software, 57(1), 1–27. doi:10.18637/jss.v057.i01

See also

svysem(), survey::svydesign()

Examples

design <- simulate_design(n_psu = 6, n_per = 4, n_strata = 2, seed = 1)
survey::svymean(~y, design)
#>      mean     SE
#> y 0.89019 0.2112
